{{Quote|And it's Rogue Squadron we'll be killing. For the glory of Thyferra.|Virile Lead|<ref name="BW" />}}
'''Virile Lead''' was the callsign for the commander of [[Virile Squadron]], a [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] squadron of the [[Thyferran Home Defense Corps]]. During the [[Battle of Thyferra]], Virile Squadron went against [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and lost ten units on the first pass.<ref name="BW" />
